chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

key_terms.خِلَافِهِنَّ: opposing them; acting contrary to them
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.قَالَ: said; introduces the statement of the Imam عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali عليه السلام mean by saying, "In opposing them is blessing"?
ai.summary: This hadith states that blessing lies in مخالفة to those being referred to in the context of the report. It conveys a brief ethical teaching that guidance and benefit may be found in not following a certain group's direction or preference.
